admin.position_help: Where the trail sits on a page.
admin.style_help: How the trail looks. Both use your theme's own colours.
admin.style_tabs: Tabs — each step on its own slanted tab
admin.home_help: What the first crumb, which always links to your forum's home page, is called.
admin.home_text_label: Custom name for the first crumb
admin.home_text_help: Leave empty to use the choice above. Fill it in to call it anything you like, such as "Forum".
admin.home_target_help: If your home page is a landing page visitors only see once, point the first crumb at the tags page so it takes them back into the forum instead.
admin.tags_text_help: What the trail calls the tags page. Leave empty for "Tags"; many forums prefer "Forums" or "Categories".
admin.mobile_help: A long trail can take several lines on a narrow screen.
admin.mobile_collapse: Shorten it — Home, … and the last two crumbs, the rest on a tap
admin.show_other_help: The discussion list, settings, notifications, and pages added by other extensions (named after the page's own title).
